scientific_limitations: The if-and-only-if applies to even-versus-odd cubic pairs. It gives noninjectivity of the full cubic design at resonance, not injectivity off resonance. The discrepancy formula is witness-specific and does not provide the global sharp conditioning.
title: A geometric-radius resonance for parity-separated cubic phase retrieval on three four-point circles
